tokens.name: wiki-white
tokens.usage: Primary surface: page background, card and input fills, and the ink of a label sitting on wiki-link. 16.1:1 under wiki-text in light, 13.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: wiki-offwhite
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: section fills, code blocks, the citation output well, notice backgrounds, and input fills in dark. wiki-text reads 15.4:1 on it in light, 13.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: wiki-tab-bg
tokens.usage: Recessed fill: inactive tabs, card headers, button and menu-item hover, drag handles, kbd keys, selected calendar day, avatar fallback.

tokens.name: wiki-border
tokens.usage: Strong 1px divider: the header's bottom edge, a toast's outline, the Clerk card edge, the warn notice's left rule. 2.3:1 on wiki-white, so it is a divider, never a meaning-carrying mark on its own.

tokens.name: wiki-border-light
tokens.usage: Subtle 1px divider: cards, inputs, dropdowns, tabs strip, footer, table rules, kbd edges. Decorative only; pair it with a label, never use it alone to carry state.

tokens.name: wiki-text
tokens.usage: All body copy, headings and labels. On wiki-white 16.1:1 light / 13.9:1 dark; on wiki-offwhite 15.4:1 / 13.2:1; on wiki-tab-bg 14.5:1 / 11.6:1. Also the focus ring's ink.

tokens.name: wiki-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: captions, placeholders, breadcrumb separators, hints, in-text citations. On wiki-white 7.4:1 light / 7.3:1 dark; on wiki-offwhite 7.0:1 / 6.9:1; on wiki-tab-bg 6.6:1 / 6.1:1.

tokens.name: wiki-link
tokens.usage: Every interactive element: links, primary button text, inline [bracket] actions, tab labels, active tags, selection highlight, caret, the selected-card border. On wiki-white 8.6:1 light / 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: wiki-link-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered hyperlink ink. Set on the a:hover rule in globals.css; components use hover:underline instead, so this applies to prose links only.

tokens.name: wiki-link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited hyperlink ink (a:visited). 11.7:1 on wiki-white light, 9.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: wiki-link-active
tokens.usage: Pressed hyperlink ink (a:active). The only red in the system; it signals a press, never an error state.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Identity blue, outside the theme tokens: the PWA manifest theme_color, the browser theme-color meta, and the count chip on the embeddable badge. Never used for in-app UI; that is wiki-link's job.

tokens.name: badge-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of the embeddable /api/badge SVG and the PWA manifest background_color. Fixed in the SVG, so it does not follow the viewer's theme.

tokens.name: badge-border
tokens.usage: 1px frame of the embeddable badge SVG. Same value as wiki-text-muted in dark, but authored independently inside public/badge.svg.

tokens.name: mark-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of <mark> in search results and docs. Carries wiki-text on top: 15.6:1 in light, 9.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: The fixed inset-0 scrim behind every modal, the command palette and the shortcut sheet. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: barnstar-highlight
tokens.usage: Inner stop of the barnstar award medal's radial gradient. Decorative; the only gradient in the system.

tokens.name: barnstar-gold
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the barnstar medal gradient, and the colour people recognise the award by.

tokens.name: barnstar-shade
tokens.usage: Outer stop of the barnstar medal gradient.

tokens.name: barnstar-stroke
tokens.usage: 2px outline of the barnstar polygon. 3.4:1 on barnstar-gold, so the medal's silhouette holds at 48px.

tokens.name: tag-active-inner-border
tokens.usage: Divider between the swatch and the label button inside a selected tag pill. Shared by all ten palette slots.

tokens.name: tag-gray-bg
tokens.usage: Resting fill of a palette-slot-0 tag pill. Carries tag-gray-text.

tokens.name: tag-gray-text

tokens.name: tag-gray-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a resting palette-slot-0 tag pill.

tokens.name: tag-gray-active-bg

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, at the top of main. Rendered as text-2xl font-bold.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section heading inside a page. Rendered as text-lg font-semibold.

styles.name: modal-heading
styles.usage: Title in a modal, dialog or sheet header. Rendered as font-bold text-base.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy, set on body in globals.css. Every page inherits it.
styles.sample: Paste a URL, DOI, ISBN, PubMed ID or arXiv ID.

styles.name: body-tight
styles.usage: Copy inside a control or dense row, where Tailwind's text-sm line-height applies instead of body's 1.6: buttons, tabs, menu items, list rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field label above its input, and the name in a card header. Never a floating or placeholder-replacing label.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, hints, keyboard shortcut hints, tag labels, footnotes. Set it in wiki-text-muted.

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: A caption that names a field or a count inside a card header.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Group heading inside the command palette and the source-type menu. Uppercase, in wiki-text-muted.

styles.name: in-text
styles.usage: In-text citation rendered inline in prose, via the .in-text-citation class. Italic, always in wiki-text-muted.

styles.name: citation
styles.usage: Every formatted citation, via the .citation-text class. The only monospace running text in the product; it makes hanging indents and punctuation countable.
styles.sample: Smith, J. (2024). Title of work. Publisher.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: A key name inside <kbd>. Pairs with wiki-tab-bg and shadow-kbd.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in documentation prose (.docs-content code), on wiki-offwhite inside a wiki-border-light box.

styles.name: docs-h1
styles.usage: Page title inside rendered documentation (.docs-content h1).

styles.name: docs-h2
styles.usage: Documentation section heading, underlined by a wiki-border-light rule and anchor-linked on hover.

styles.name: docs-body
styles.usage: Documentation paragraphs, lists and table cells.

styles.name: docs-pre
styles.usage: Code inside a documentation <pre> block, in wiki-text-muted on wiki-offwhite.

spacing.note: The five space-* tokens are declared in the @theme block of globals.css but no utility consumes them yet; the product spaces on Tailwind's 0.25rem step scale, which the pad-*, gap-* and stack-* tokens below record.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Declared as --spacing-section for page-level section gaps. Not yet consumed by any utility.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Declared as --spacing-card for card padding. Not yet consumed; cards use pad-card or pad-card-lg.

tokens.name: space-field
tokens.usage: Declared as --spacing-field for the gap between form fields. Not yet consumed; forms use stack-field.

tokens.name: space-paragraph
tokens.usage: Declared as --spacing-paragraph for vertical rhythm between paragraphs. Not yet consumed.

tokens.name: space-button
tokens.usage: Declared as --spacing-button for button vertical padding. Not yet consumed; buttons use pad-button-y.

tokens.name: pad-button-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a WikiButton and a WikiDropdown trigger (px-4).

tokens.name: pad-button-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a WikiButton, a tab and a WikiDropdown trigger (py-2).

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Body padding of a citation card, a toast and a modal-free panel (p-4).

tokens.name: pad-card-lg
tokens.usage: Body padding of a modal dialog (p-5) and its header's horizontal inset (px-5).

tokens.name: pad-card-head
tokens.usage: Padding of a card header strip on wiki-tab-bg (p-3).

tokens.name: pad-header-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal inset of the app header, footer and main column (px-4).

tokens.name: pad-header-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the app header bar (py-3).

tokens.name: pad-list-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a menu item, listbox option, sidebar link or list row (px-3).

tokens.name: pad-list-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a menu item or list row (py-2). Listbox options use 6px (py-1.5).

tokens.name: pad-input
tokens.usage: Padding inside a bare input, textarea or select, set on the element in globals.css.

tokens.name: pad-input-tight
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of an inline edit input inside a citation card (py-1); its horizontal padding is gap-default.

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Gap between a breadcrumb item and its separator, and inside a tag pill (gap-1).

tokens.name: gap-default
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls in a row: card header items, button groups, tag rows (gap-2).

tokens.name: gap-loose
tokens.usage: Gap between a toast's icon and its text, and between inline [bracket] actions (gap-3).

tokens.name: gap-nav
tokens.usage: Gap between header nav links and between command palette footer hints (gap-4).

tokens.name: stack-field
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between consecutive form fields (space-y-4). The canonical form spacing.

tokens.name: stack-tight
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm inside a field group: label to input, list item to list item (space-y-1).

tokens.name: footer-offset
tokens.usage: Space above the footer rule (mt-12), the one large vertical gap in the layout.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: outline-offset on the dotted focus ring.

radius.note: OpenCitation has exactly one radius value. Nothing in the product rounds: not buttons, inputs, cards, modals, avatars, tags or menus. Clerk's injected UI is overridden to 0 in globals.css to hold the rule.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner in the system. There is no second radius token; adding one breaks the 2005 flat-web idiom the product is built on.

shadow.note: Flat-first: depth comes from 1px borders and surface contrast. Shadow is spent on exactly three roles.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The default for every surface: cards, panels, inputs, tabs, tags, the header, the footer.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus that float over content: WikiDropdown, WikiSelect listbox, WikiDatePicker calendar, SourceTypePicker menu, TagColorPicker.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs, the command palette, the shortcut sheet, and a citation card while it is being dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-kbd
tokens.usage: Inner bottom edge of a <kbd> key, paired with a 2px bottom border so a key reads as physical.

border.note: Every border in the system is 1px except the five widths recorded here.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border, divider and rule unless listed below.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: A selected citation card's wiki-link border, which replaces the 1px wiki-border-light edge.

tokens.name: border-notice-info
tokens.usage: Left rule of an info WikiNotice, in wiki-border-light.

tokens.name: border-notice-warn
tokens.usage: Left rule of a warn WikiNotice, in wiki-border. Weight, not hue, is what separates warn from info.

tokens.name: border-kbd-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom border of a <kbd> key.

tokens.name: border-quote
tokens.usage: Left rule on a quoted line inside a citation card's notes list.

tokens.name: border-focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of the dotted :focus-visible outline, in wiki-text.

tokens.name: width-container
tokens.usage: Max width of the header, main column and footer. Wikipedia's reading column; declared as --width-container.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Declared as --width-content for a narrower prose measure. Not yet consumed by a utility.

tokens.name: width-modal
tokens.usage: Max width of a modal, the command palette and the shortcut sheet (max-w-xl).

tokens.name: width-menu-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a WikiDropdown menu, so short labels do not produce a sliver.

tokens.name: width-user-menu
tokens.usage: Fixed width of the WikiUserMenu panel (w-48).

tokens.name: width-toast
tokens.usage: Width of the barnstar toast at sm and above; below that it is the viewport minus 32px.

tokens.name: width-docs-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the documentation sidebar (w-44).

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Default WikiUserMenu avatar, image or initials fallback.

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Compact WikiUserMenu avatar, used in the mobile header.

tokens.name: size-day-cell
tokens.usage: A day button in the WikiDatePicker calendar grid.

tokens.name: size-scrollbar
tokens.usage: Width and height of the themed WebKit scrollbar.

tokens.name: height-menu-max
tokens.usage: Max height of a WikiSelect listbox before it scrolls.

tokens.name: height-palette-max
tokens.usage: Max height of the command palette result list (max-h-80).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Any disabled control, always with cursor-not-allowed. The only disabled signal in the system.

tokens.name: opacity-drag-source
tokens.usage: A citation card's original position while its ghost is being dragged. Applied by dnd-kit; do not override.

tokens.name: opacity-spinner-track
tokens.usage: The stationary ring of the WikiSpinner SVG.

tokens.name: opacity-spinner-head
tokens.usage: The sweeping arc of the WikiSpinner SVG.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Alpha of overlay-scrim behind a modal.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: A citation card lifted by a drag.

tokens.name: z-tab-active
tokens.usage: The active tab, so its -1px bottom margin paints over the strip's border.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: WikiDropdown menus, WikiSelect listboxes, SourceTypePicker menus, TagColorPicker.

tokens.name: z-datepicker
tokens.usage: The WikiDatePicker calendar, which must clear a dropdown opened in the same form row.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modals, the command palette, the shortcut sheet, the user menu, toasts and the offline indicator.

tokens.name: z-install-banner
tokens.usage: The Safari install banner, which sits above everything including an open modal.
